select
date_format(o.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00') as bucketKey,
date_format(o.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as bucketKey,
sum(o.total_amount) as amount from biz_order o where o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and o.status = 'PAID' and o.deleted = 0 and o.updated_at >= #{start} and o.updated_at < #{end} group by bucketKey order by bucketKey

select i.product_id as productId, max(i.product_name) as productName, sum(i.amount) as amount, sum(sum(i.amount)) over () as totalAmount from biz_order o inner join biz_order_item i on i.order_id = o.id and i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and i.deleted = 0 where o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and o.status = 'PAID' and o.deleted = 0 and o.updated_at >= #{start} and o.updated_at < #{end} group by i.product_id order by amount desc, i.product_id limit #{limit}
